message.description: A refusal's words: as written, or {"fmt": "…{field}…"} filled from the run's values ({{ and }} are braces).

answer.description: Agent Link only: the answer. via: the family helper that finishes it (with: its arguments; $fields is the fields); fields: the answer's own fields in order ("...": a dict spread in; {"when", "value"}: only then); late: the helper reads the fields itself, after its recompute; then: steps run once the answer is made ("out"); first: expressions run before the fields are read.

step.description: One step: exactly one of let, refuse, make, add, set, do, put, push, each, choose, try, then, answer.

when.description: The step runs only when this is truthy.

let.description: Values by name, in order; "p, q" unpacks.

first.description: What to undo before the refusal.

make.description: A maker's dotted name (Arch.makeStairs), or =expression giving one.

do.description: An expression, or a list of them, for what they do.

into.description: The dict's name; the answer (out) when left out.

push.description: A list's name and one more for it.

on.description: error (any), refusal (a tool's own), failure (any error but a tool's own refusal), or a list of Python error names.

reraise.description: After the except steps (what to undo), the error goes on as it was.

answer.description: Ends the run with this answer.

$comment: The tool-data format Agent Link reads (agentlink/tooldata.py). One file per add-on: <package>/data/tools.json.

heavy.description: A long job: queued, timed, given a deadline.

writes.description: Its path is a file it writes, not reads.

pathIsCurve.description: Its path is a curve in the model, not a file.

reads.description: For a changing tool, the calls that only read: an argument and the values that make a call a read, e.g. {"action": ["list"]}. Such a call is no undo step, marks nothing changed and is not shown as a change.

runner.description: Agent Link's own tools only: the runner (agentlink/runners.py) that runs this entry: a wrapper of one FreeCAD command (make, apply, command, read; with target, args, rules) or a list of steps. Add-ons bind handlers instead.

family.description: Agent Link only: where two family modules share a group, the module whose helpers this entry calls (bim_more).

steps.description: Agent Link only, with the steps runner: what the tool does, in order. Each step is one action, and "when" (an expression) on any step runs it only then. A value starting with = is an expression (agentlink/expr.py): arithmetic, comparisons, conditionals, lists, the family's helpers by name; never eval.

target.description: Agent Link only: what the runner runs (maker or type, method, command, or what to read).

args.description: Agent Link only: each argument's default, conversion, family helper, property or step after the object is made.

rules.description: Agent Link only: the checks the handler made, each with its refusal message word for word.

activity.description: What a call did, in the Activity tab's words: a template whose {fields} come from the call's arguments or answer, e.g. "Sliced {object}". The first template whose fields are all given is used; " if {field}" at the end makes it conditional.

workbench.description: FreeCAD's workbench class name the tool belongs to (PartDesignWorkbench, MeshWorkbench …): tool_groups { find } lifts it for a search that names the workbench, { now: true } when that workbench is in front. Left out for none.

commands.description: The FreeCAD commands the tool does the work of (Mesh_Decimating): found by their names, and where a command reports itself active in the window the tool fits now.

words.description: A few search words a person would use that the tool's name lacks ("round" for a fillet).
